# Mindfulness Meditación Guiada (Z Meditations)

> Mindfulness Meditación Guiada ("Mindfulness: Guided Meditation" in English) is a guided meditation app for iPhone and iPad by Z Meditations, on the App Store since December 2012 (app id 572966485). Free to download, with free content that never expires; the optional Mindfulness Pro unlocks the rest. No account needed. Not available on Android.

## Facts

- More than 100 voice-guided sessions, from 2 to 50 minutes; you pick the length of each session.
- 112 guided sessions in 12 topics, and 10 collections where you pick the length.
- Sleep sessions of 10 to 50 minutes: the background sound fades out and stops by itself when you choose (when the voice ends, or 15, 30 or 45 minutes later; it can also keep playing). Background sounds: rain, ocean, forest, river, fire, white noise.
- The home screen suggests a session for the time of day (morning, afternoon, night).
- 12 multi-day programs of 3 to 21 days, one short session per day; "Empieza a meditar" (Start meditating) is a 5-day beginner program, about 9 minutes a day.
- 61 techniques explained step by step (for example body scan, breathing, loving-kindness, labeling).
- 11 exercises without voice, including breathing that follows a circle: 4-7-8, box breathing (4-4-4-4) and 5-5. The free course "Fundamentos de la respiración" (5 lessons) teaches 4-7-8 (lesson 3) and box breathing (lesson 4).
- Silent meditation timer with bells.
- Mood diary before and after each session, with a weekly view; stored in the user's iCloud.
- Works offline for downloaded sessions; home screen widgets; optional Apple Health minutes.
- App languages (10): Spanish, English, German, French, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.

## Links

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id572966485
- Website: https://www.zmeditations.com/ (Spanish today; other languages later, each in its own folder such as /en/)
- Contact: zmeditations@gmail.com

## Pages (Spanish)

- [Inicio](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/): what the app is, what is free, what is inside
- [Ayuda](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/soporte/): short answers (free content, restoring purchases, cancelling, diary in iCloud, languages, contact)
- [Respiración 4-7-8](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/respiracion-4-7-8/): how to do 4-7-8 breathing step by step, with a breathing guide on the page
- [Respiración cuadrada](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/respiracion-cuadrada/): how to do box breathing step by step, with a breathing guide on the page
- [Meditación guiada para dormir](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/meditacion-para-dormir/): the 12 sleep sessions (10 to 50 minutes), sleep sounds and auto stop
- [Empieza a meditar: 5 días para empezar el año](https://www.zmeditations.com/es/reto/): the 5-day beginner program, free from 1 to 31 January 2027
- [Privacidad](https://www.zmeditations.com/privacy.html): privacy policy
